purpose: Simplification roadmap after the Datastar + Effect framework philosophy audit. These tasks remove accidental complexity, narrow public API surface, and preserve the server-driven identity before users exist.

grill_scale.3: Design cleanup with a recommended answer; brief review is useful.
grill_scale.4: Major public-shape decision; challenge the direction before implementation.
grill_scale.5: Identity-defining decision; ask before committing if the direction is not already explicit.

tasks.title: Write the simplification charter and smallest blessed core
tasks.goal: Replace growth-oriented framing with an audit-driven charter that names the smallest conceptual core and anti-goals.
tasks.canonical_direction: ts-star is an Effect-native, server-driven Datastar framework; not a frontend runtime, plugin platform, or generic web framework.
deliverables: Simplification charter in docs or README
Smallest blessed core listed explicitly
Foundational vs accidental abstractions named
Anti-goals updated to reject compatibility layers before users exist
removal_targets: docs implying all current modules deserve public status

tasks.title: Curate root exports and create a real internal boundary
tasks.goal: Stop exporting every prototype helper as public API and force intentional promotion of modules/functions.
tasks.canonical_direction: Prefer namespace exports for a small blessed set; remove root-level named re-exports and hide experimental modules.
deliverables: Curated src/index.ts
Internal boundary for implementation-only code
Tests updated to assert the new public surface
Docs updated to use the canonical import style
removal_targets: root-level convenience exports that make everything public

tasks.title: Make SSE-first responses the blessed response path
tasks.goal: Collapse duplicate response constructors around Datastar SSE as the canonical response model.
tasks.canonical_direction: Use one cohesive public response factory named reply. SSE patch helpers are top-level and blessed; direct HTML/signals/script responses remain as reply.direct.* status-safe escape hatches. Remove verbose datastar* names, DatastarResponse, ds.reply, and public arbitrary-status platform direct helpers.
deliverables: One cohesive public reply factory, inspired by Remix-style contextual naming
Duplicate platform/datastar direct response pairs removed
Direct response helpers kept only as secondary status-safe escape hatches
Examples rewritten to use SSE-first helpers by default
removal_targets: unnecessary platform* vs datastar* direct response duplication
direct helpers appearing as peers of canonical SSE helpers
verbose datastar*Response names in public app ergonomics
DatastarResponse or ds.reply as public response namespaces

tasks.title: Replace Runtime service catalog with explicit read/reply APIs and app-owned Effect services
tasks.goal: Remove the public ts-star Runtime service catalog while preserving Effect as the app-owned dependency/resource model.
tasks.canonical_direction: Normal apps use h, ds, read, and reply. Request decoding is read.signals/read.query; responses are reply.*; app dependencies are plain Effect services/layers owned by the app. Runtime services are deleted or internal only.
deliverables: Public read.signals/read.query helper namespace
Runtime namespace removed from public exports
Thin runtime services deleted or moved internal without aliases
Runtime counter rewritten as an app-owned Effect services example
Docs explain where Effect remains valuable without a ts-star runtime service graph

tasks.title: Replace Contracts with a narrow contract.signals API
tasks.goal: Keep schema-derived signal type safety while removing request decoding, response construction, route/action contracts, and runtime coupling from contracts.
tasks.canonical_direction: Expose lowercase contract.signals(schema). It returns { schema, $, initial, patch }. Decode with read.signals(Contact.schema), respond with reply.signals(Contact.patch(...)), and type patches as contract.Patch<typeof Contact>. No route/action DSL or contract-owned read/reply methods.
deliverables: Lowercase contract namespace/file replacing public Contracts
contract.signals(schema) factory returning { schema, $, initial, patch }
contract.Signals<Shape> public return type
contract.Patch<typeof Contact> public patch type with hidden recursive internals
Action/query contract DSL removed
Examples updated to use Contact.$, read.signals(Contact.schema), and reply.signals(Contact.patch(...))
removal_targets: Contracts namespace and defineSignals public name
SignalContract public name and read/readFromRequest/decode/patchResponse fields

tasks.title: Shape ds as thin Datastar mirrors, not a client DSL
tasks.goal: Expose a lowercase ds namespace for browser-facing Datastar primitives while removing invented expression DSL helpers, aliases, and non-Datastar concerns.
tasks.canonical_direction: Public app code uses ds.* for Datastar attributes/actions/signals. Keep broad thin mirrors of documented Datastar concepts, expose ds.delete(...), keep Signal as reference/path only, remove expression combinators and aliases, move mergeAttrs out of ds, and keep serializers/modifier builders internal.
deliverables: Lowercase public ds namespace/object replacing app-facing Datastar namespace
Public ds.delete(...) with reserved-word workaround hidden internally
Broad thin mirrors of documented Datastar attributes/actions retained
Invented expression DSL helpers removed from public API
Signal mutator/comparison helpers removed; path/reference behavior retained
Local signal helper standardized as ds.local(...)
mergeAttrs moved out of ds or deferred to HTML boundary cleanup
Modifier builders and serialization helpers made internal
removal_targets: Datastar namespace as app-facing public style
ds.del public API in favor of ds.delete
inputSignal/privateSignal/privateSignalName public aliases unless needed for ds.local internals
validationSignal/loadingSignal and validation/loading data-signal helpers in core ds

tasks.title: Simplify the HTML and JSX boundary
tasks.goal: Expose a small server HTML API and prevent JSX from becoming a React-like component runtime direction.
tasks.canonical_direction: Make h/render the conceptual default; keep JSX internal or explicitly experimental syntax sugar.
deliverables: Minimal public HTML API
Renderer/ordered-attribute details hidden unless proven necessary
JSX docs demoted or removed
Tests updated around the chosen boundary
removal_targets: Renderer public interface until adapter evidence exists
Jsx root namespace if not intentionally experimental

tasks.title: Merge realtime around current-state live queries
tasks.goal: Remove overlapping realtime abstractions and make reconnect-safe current-state live queries the one obvious model.
tasks.canonical_direction: Use Model.liveQuery/liveQueryResponse as the canonical realtime abstraction; let apps use Effect PubSub/Stream directly unless a tiny helper is clearly useful.
deliverables: Realtime module merged, shrunk, or removed from public API
Live query example reflects invalidation/load/render semantics
Generic live element streaming helpers removed from public API
Reconnect semantics documented and tested
removal_targets: LiveQuery object alias if direct functions are enough

tasks.title: Move Security, Validation, and Observability out of public core
tasks.goal: Prevent generic auth/security/validation/telemetry modules from defining the framework identity too early.
tasks.canonical_direction: Move these concerns to recipes or internals. Core should expose primitives, not public subsystems.
deliverables: Security namespace removed from public core
Validation namespace removed from public core or turned into a recipe
Observability namespace removed from public core
Docs clarify these are application concerns
removal_targets: Telemetry service and observe* wrappers as public core
custom framework facades for concerns better owned by apps

tasks.title: Trim the generic Platform HTTP surface
tasks.goal: Keep Platform focused on Datastar + Effect Platform integration instead of wrapping generic HTTP helpers.
tasks.canonical_direction: Keep Datastar-specific signal/query decoding and canonical responses; use Effect Platform directly for generic form/multipart APIs.
deliverables: Generic form/multipart wrappers removed from public API
Datastar signal/query decoding remains tested
Canonical response names aligned with T003
Docs point to Effect Platform for generic HTTP needs
removal_targets: generic HTTP wrappers added for convenience

tasks.title: Simplify Datastar client asset helpers
tasks.goal: Keep script/document/client serving helpers small and remove tuple route composition convenience APIs.
tasks.canonical_direction: Keep document/script helpers and one asset route helper; remove route-list helpers and unneeded configuration surface.
deliverables: Client helper surface reduced
Tuple route helpers removed
Page response naming aligned with T003
Examples/dev server updated
removal_targets: excess asset configuration without a current example

tasks.title: Rewrite docs and examples around one blessed path
tasks.goal: Teach the cleaned framework identity instead of cataloging every prototype helper or preserving old approaches.
tasks.canonical_direction: Docs and examples should show render HTML, attach Datastar attrs, decode inputs, mutate/read backend state, return 204 or SSE patches, and use live queries for realtime.
deliverables: README rewritten around the blessed path
Examples updated or deleted
Docs for removed modules deleted or rewritten as recipes
Compatibility/stability language removed

tasks.title: Run the final surface audit and dead-code cleanup
tasks.goal: Verify that the cleanup actually reduced conceptual surface area and left no compatibility shims or duplicate abstractions.
tasks.canonical_direction: Measure success by local reasoning and one obvious path, not by feature count.
deliverables: Dead references removed
Focused tests for remaining blessed path
Typecheck/test/example checks passing
Final public export list reviewed
removal_targets: unused internal files kept for possible future use
